test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I __used to swim across__ the river when I was young.
solution:
The correct answer is: **could swim across**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace "**used to**" with "**could**" to correct the sentence.
